name: legal-research
description: Verified legal research, citation checking, proofreading, and Zotero library workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Research, cite-check, and proofread legal scholarship
interface.longDescription: Six research workflows with source verification, evidence records, and completion checks. Includes legal memos, citation finding, citation checking, internal proofreading, Zotero library building, and deep research. Requires a Codex environment with local file and script access; external research and library operations use the user's available tools and credentials.
defaultPrompt: Use $legal-research:legal-research-memo to research this legal question.
Use $legal-research:cite-check to verify the citations in this draft.
